item.summary: fix: gateway stalls for tens of seconds after each agent turn on multi-agent installs (#120075) * fix(sessions): reuse database path identities during target resolution Prepare filesystem identities once per synchronous session-target operation and share the matcher across collision, fixed-store, and registered-owner scans while preserving uncached comparator and filesystem-error behavior. Fixes #120074. Co-authored-by: Sergio * test(sessions): split target dedupe regressions * test(sessions): remove stale dedupe import Co-authored-by: Sergio --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
